summary: The equivalence is exactly supplied by accepted fact 2c093df4eb8158a9. Accepted fact 4c1fd13733ff0675 applies simultaneously to the jointly feasible family and preserves masses, first moments, pointwise log-concavity after zero extension, and the single common pointwise capacity. After normalization, each resulting density defines a compactly supported log-concave Radon probability measure with barycenter p_j, so the cited log-concave Grunbaum inequality gives mass at least 1/e in the oriented closed halfspace through p_j. For any closed halfspace H containing p_j, that centroid halfspace is contained in H; summing over all such labels and using the common capacity yields the claimed aggregate halfspace domination. Proper, boundary, whole-space, and empty cases are all handled correctly.
